sections.heading: Is IG Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Fifty-one years without a major regulatory scandal. Listed on the FTSE 100 with a market capitalisation north of GBP 4.5 billion. Eight Tier-1 regulatory licences spanning the FCA, ASIC, NFA/CFTC, MAS, DFSA, AMF, FMA, and FSA Japan. Revenue exceeding GBP 1 billion in 2025 with 313,000+ active clients and organic new customer growth up 54% year-on-year. These are not broker-marketing numbers — they are audited public company disclosures filed with the London Stock Exchange. IG is not just a legit broker. It is what institutional trust looks like packaged for retail traders. The 68% retail loss rate is the lowest we have seen in any broker review — still majority losses, because CFDs are inherently high-risk instruments, but demonstrably better outcomes than the 75-80% typical at most competitors.

The catch is straightforward and worth stating plainly: you pay for this safety in spread. EUR/USD from 0.6 pips with no raw-spread commission account available means a scalper executing 50 lots per day pays roughly $3 more per lot than they would at IC Markets on a raw-spread setup. Over a month, that adds up to real money. IG does not pretend to be the cheapest. It never has been. What it offers instead is the certainty that your counterparty will exist tomorrow, next year, and next decade — backed by public market accountability that no privately-held broker can replicate.

IG is built for traders and investors who want a single platform covering CFDs, spread betting, shares, ISAs, SIPPs, and options — under the strongest regulatory framework available anywhere at retail level.

sections.heading: Is IG Regulated? — Licence Check 2026
sections.body:
Yes — and more thoroughly than any other broker we have reviewed. IG holds 8 Tier-1 regulatory licences across every major financial jurisdiction on earth. The primary UK entity operates under the Financial Conduct Authority with FSCS protection covering client funds up to GBP 85,000. This is real government-backed compensation — not marketing language, not fund segregation alone, but actual insurance if the entity fails.

The Australian entity sits under ASIC, providing mandatory client fund segregation in AA-rated banks but no compensation scheme. The US entity is registered with the NFA and regulated by the CFTC — making IG one of fewer than five brokers globally that can legally accept American retail forex clients. MAS in Singapore, DFSA in Dubai, FSA in Japan, AMF in France, and FMA in New Zealand complete the regulatory architecture. The international entity operates under the Bermuda Monetary Authority for clients outside these core jurisdictions.

What does this mean practically? You are almost certainly trading under a Tier-1 regulator regardless of where you live. The entity routing is not a question of offshore-versus-regulated — it is a question of which Tier-1 authority governs your account. That distinction matters. IG received its FCA cryptoasset licence in 2024, further expanding its regulated product offering. No active warnings on any regulatory list. No kill-switch triggers. The cleanest regulatory record of any broker in our queue. NAFT last reviewed IG regulation in May 2026.

sections.heading: IG Spreads, Fees and Accounts — What Do You Actually Pay in 2026?
sections.body:
EUR/USD from 0.6 pips, no commission. That is $6 all-in cost per standard lot on the main forex pairs. For indices, spreads start from 0.8 points on FTSE 100 and 1.0 point on Wall Street — tight enough for swing traders but not the absolute cheapest available. Commodities from 0.1 points on oil and 0.3 on gold. IG operates a spread-only model on forex and most CFDs, meaning there is no raw-spread alternative with a separate commission. You see one number and that is what you pay.

The DMA service via L2 Dealer gives institutional clients direct market access with variable pricing based on order book depth. This is not a retail product — it is designed for professionals executing larger size who need to interact with the order book directly. Spread betting is available for UK residents and carries a significant advantage: profits are currently exempt from capital gains tax and stamp duty under UK tax law. That tax efficiency alone can offset the wider spread versus an ECN broker for UK-based traders doing material volume.

Leverage is capped at 1:30 on forex majors across all Tier-1 entities (FCA, ASIC, MAS). The US entity operates at 1:50 on majors under CFTC rules. Japan at 1:25. IG does not offer 1:500 leverage anywhere — this is a broker that follows regulatory caps without offshore workarounds. No inactivity fee for 2 years. After 24 months of dormancy, a GBP 12 per month inactivity fee applies — low compared to industry norms but worth knowing before you leave an account idle.

sections.heading: How Fast Can You Get Your Money Out of IG?
sections.body:
E-wallet withdrawals process same-day. Bank wire takes 2-5 business days depending on your local banking infrastructure — standard for any FTSE 100 financial institution moving money through the correspondent banking network. IG charges zero withdrawal fees on their side across all methods. No hidden processing charges, no minimum withdrawal thresholds designed to trap small balances.

Debit and credit card deposits are instant. PayPal is instant. Bank transfer takes 1-3 business days to land depending on your bank. The minimum deposit is $50 for card payments — unusually low for a broker of this calibre — and there is no minimum for bank wire transfers. That low barrier to entry combined with the regulatory strength is a genuine differentiator. You do not need $10,000 to access an FCA-regulated, FTSE 100-listed broker.

Withdrawals follow standard AML compliance: funds return to their original source up to the deposited amount. Profits above that threshold can be withdrawn via bank wire. The same-source rule is not IG-specific — it is a regulatory requirement across all Tier-1 jurisdictions. Keep your payment details current to avoid delays.

table.footnote: Same-day processing for e-wallets and cards (broker-stated). Bank wire timing depends on local banking infrastructure. No withdrawal fees from IG.

sections.heading: IG Withdrawals in 2026 — The Real Picture
sections.body:
Trustpilot shows 4.0 out of 5 from over 8,000 reviews. 56% five-star, 18% one-star. That polarisation is worth understanding — the one-star cluster comes primarily from traders who lost money on positions and conflate trading losses with broker misconduct. Genuine withdrawal complaints are a minority within that 18%. IG responds to negative Trustpilot reviews publicly, which at their scale represents a meaningful customer service commitment. The review velocity is consistent with a broker of this size — no manipulation signals, no suspicious spikes.

The positive pattern is strong and specific. Institutional infrastructure means IG processes withdrawals with the operational discipline of a publicly listed financial company answerable to shareholders, auditors, and the FCA simultaneously. When a FTSE 100 company delays a withdrawal, it creates a regulatory and reputational risk that scales far beyond the individual transaction. That accountability mechanism is why large regulated brokers almost never have systemic withdrawal issues — the cost of failure is too high.

The small number of documented complaints typically involve first-time withdrawals triggering enhanced due diligence, large withdrawals requiring manual approval (standard AML compliance for amounts above certain thresholds), or bank-side processing delays misattributed to IG. If your withdrawal stalls: confirm your KYC documents are current and fully verified. Check that you are withdrawing to the same source as your deposit. Contact IG support directly — they operate extended hours. If unresolved after 5 business days, the FCA complaint procedure is available for UK clients, and each jurisdiction has an equivalent escalation path through the local regulator.

sections.heading: How to Open an IG Account — Step by Step
sections.body: Registration takes under 10 minutes. IG asks more compliance questions than most brokers — income source, trading experience, employment status — because Tier-1 regulators require it. Full verification typically completes within 24 hours. You can start with a demo account immediately while KYC processes.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: Visit ig.com and select Create Account. Choose your country of residence — this determines your regulatory entity automatically. Select CFD, spread betting, or share dealing depending on your needs. Complete the compliance questionnaire honestly — incorrect answers can trigger account restrictions later.

steps.title: Verify your identity (KYC)
steps.detail: Upload a government-issued photo ID (passport or driving licence) and one proof of address document dated within 3 months (utility bill, bank statement, or council tax bill). IG typically verifies within 24 hours for standard applications. Some applications require manual review, extending to 2-3 business days.

steps.title: Fund your account and test a withdrawal
steps.detail: Deposit $50 via card or PayPal for instant funding — or any amount via bank wire. Place one small trade to activate the account. Then request a partial withdrawal immediately to test the pipeline. If it processes cleanly within the stated timeframe, you know the infrastructure works before committing serious capital.

sections.practical_note: Make a small deposit. Place one trade. Request a withdrawal immediately. If it processes cleanly, scale with confidence.

sections.heading: IG Final Verdict — Is It Worth It in 2026?
sections.body:
NAFT scores IG 9.0 out of 10 — the highest trust score in our entire review queue. Eight Tier-1 regulatory licences, FTSE 100 listing, 51 years of unbroken operation, FSCS protection for UK clients, NFA registration for US access, and 19,000+ instruments under one roof. The regulation score is a perfect 10 because no retail broker on earth carries more institutional accountability. The spread cost — EUR/USD from 0.6 pips — is the honest price of that safety, and for most traders who are not scalping 50+ lots daily, the extra $3 per lot versus an ECN broker is irrelevant compared to the certainty that your counterparty is a publicly audited FTSE 100 company.

The risks are minimal but named clearly. You pay more per trade than ECN alternatives. South Africa access is ending. The inactivity fee activates after 24 months dormant. ProRealTime costs money unless you trade actively. And 68% of retail accounts still lose money — regulatory quality does not protect you from bad trading decisions, only from broker misconduct.

If you trade actively and need the cheapest possible execution, IC Markets or Pepperstone raw-spread accounts save real money over time. If you want the safest counterparty in retail trading, the broadest product range, and the confidence that comes from 51 years of public accountability — IG is the gold standard. NAFT recommends testing the withdrawal process with a small deposit before committing larger capital, as with every broker. But if any broker earns trust on reputation alone, it is this one.
